QuestInfo.name: Intel from Ereve
QuestInfo.0: Olive's come up with some wild story about a master of disguise, but it sounds a little too convenient. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart corroborates Olive's story and says his knights and the Explorers must work together against the Black Mage. He writes a letter about the Master of Disguise and gives it to you. \r\nTake it to Rondo then speak to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: You deliver the letter to Rondo and he scampers off to report to the Dark Lord. Report to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Deliver the letter from Neinheart to Rondo and report the incident to Athena Pierce.

0.0: Welcome to Ereve. How may I assist you?\r\n#L0##bDo you know anything about a villian who's really good with disguises?#l\n#k
0.1: Once, not too long ago, a Master of Disguise did in fact infiltrate Ereve. Why do you ask? \r\n#L0##b(You explain the entire situation to Neinheart. He seems trustworthy, right?)#l\n#k
0.2: I see. Then I must tell you, I've seen the Master of Disguise's abilities with my own eyes. His disguises are flawless, in terms of looks. Utterly perfect. If it weren't for a certain knight, I'm not sure what would have become of Ereve. \r\n#L0##bWho saved Ereve?#l\n#k
0.3: It is a lengthy story. I will write a letter to Athena Pierce explaining all that happened. There, I'm done. Take is to the representative from the Theives' Guild.

yes.0: The Cygnus Knights and Explorers must combine their forces to combat the Black Mage. Come find me when you've made your preparations and are ready to work together.

no.0: You can keep it for yourself if you like. It doesn't matter to me.

1.0: Back from Ereve already, #h0#? How was everything?

npc.0: Deliver the letter to the leader of the Thieves' Guild representative.
